oldStatement: ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → IsGreatest {C : ℝ | ∃ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → a (n + 1) = (r : ℝ) * a n) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → (⨅ (k : ℤ), |a n - (k : ℝ)|) ≥ C)} (if Odd r then (1 / 2 : ℝ) else (r : ℝ) / (2 * ((r : ℝ) + 1)))

∀ (A B C D E F P Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
  (A ≠ B ∧ B ≠ C ∧ C ≠ D ∧ D ≠ A ∧ A ≠ C ∧ B ≠ D ∧
    (∃ X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), X ∈ openSegment ℝ A C ∧ X ∈ openSegment ℝ B D) ∧
    (inner (B - A) (C - A)) / (‖B - A‖ * ‖C - A‖) =
      (inner (C - A) (D - A)) / (‖C - A‖ * ‖D - A‖) ∧
    E ∈ segment ℝ B C ∧
    F ∈ segment ℝ C D ∧
    (∃ k : ℝ, k ≠ 0 ∧ F - E = k • (D - B)) ∧
    (∃ p : ℝ, p < 0 ∧ P = A + p • (F - A)) ∧
    (∃ q : ℝ, q < 0 ∧ Q = A + q • (E - A)) ∧
    (∃ (O₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r₁ : ℝ),
      r₁ > 0 ∧ dist O₁ A = r₁ ∧ dist O₁ B = r₁ ∧ dist O₁ P = r₁ ∧
      inner (O₁ - A) (C - A) = 0) ∧
    (∃ (O₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r₂ : ℝ),
      r₂ > 0 ∧ dist O₂ A = r₂ ∧ dist O₂ D = r₂ ∧ dist O₂ Q = r₂ ∧
      inner (O₂ - A) (C - A) = 0)) →
  (∃ (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ),
    r > 0 ∧ dist O B = r ∧ dist O P = r ∧ dist O Q = r ∧ dist O D = r)

∀ (A B : ℕ), 0 < A → 0 < B → ∀ S : Set ℕ, (∀ n, n ∈ S → 0 < n) → (∀ k : ℕ, A ^ k ∈ S) → (∀ n, n ∈ S → ∀ d, 0 < d → d ∣ n → d ∈ S) → (∀ m n, m ∈ S → n ∈ S → Nat.Coprime m n → m * n ∈ S) → (∀ n, n ∈ S → A * n + B ∈ S) → ∀ n, 0 < n → Nat.Coprime n B → n ∈ S
